v1.0.0-beta.1 SHIPPED 2026-05-07. The lightweight v1.0.0 tag (e3e3a61) is on the same line of history but is a placeholder, not the public stable release.

PATH TO v1.0.0 STABLE — Bun commit-phase landed in-tree 2026-05-07, awaiting push + debug-tag validation:
- Local main 7 commits ahead of origin/main (foundation cleanup + Bun swap).
- Bun build-script swap landed (0bad6e7): scripts/sea-build.js now shells out to `bun build --compile`. Local validation on darwin-arm64 passed: 64 MB binary (vs 125 MB SEA), 128ms compile (vs multi-second SEA), MCP probe clean (19 tools, initialize OK, reverie_get end-to-end).
- esbuild + postject dropped (54fb94d).
- CI workflow updated (bfaf005): setup-bun added, Node x64 tarball download step removed, --node-binary arg removed (script auto-infers target from output-name).
- src/storage.ts type-only Scope re-export shipped (0bc219a, the documented one-line Bun pre-flight).

NEXT — beta.2 cut, USER-DRIVEN:
- Push 7 local commits to origin/main.
- Debug-tag rerun (v0.0.0-debug.0 pattern from #96) to validate the bun build --compile cross-compile + lipo + codesign chain on the macOS CI runner. First beta-channel release without the SEA pipeline; CI hasn't run the new path yet.
- If debug passes: tag v1.0.0-beta.2, release pipeline auto-publishes + Homebrew tap auto-updates (per project.tracking).

DEFERRED to Reverie v1.1+:
- Test-runner swap (vitest → bun:test) — 2-4 days dominated by vi.mock auto-hoist restructuring across 31 files; per project.bunMigrationScope.
- Web app / visualization layer (mindmap, topology) — pairs with #83.
- Search improvements (#13 fzf, #43 boolean operators) — user-flagged in project.v115Hints.
- Entry health / staleness work (#84).
- Cross-machine telemetry aggregation.
- Issue #111 (zsh completions hyphen bug) — fix in src/completions.ts when convenient.

Test count at v1.14: 1394 (1232 pass under bun --bun run vitest; 160 skipped on a vitest-under-Bun module-transform issue documented in project.bunValidate). Per Option A, vitest stays under Node — no test count regression expected.

DOGFOODING PART THREE: still expected, naturally pairs with v1.0.0 stable launch as the rebrand-narrative blog post.
